newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Duma Speaker says Yeltsin should quit if too sick.
newsitem.headline: Duma Speaker says Yeltsin should quit if too sick.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin should consider retiring if doctors rule he is unfit for heart surgery and ask him to cut down on his activity, the communist speaker of Russia's State Duma lower house of parliament said on Monday.

"I think that if the doctors give the president an exact diagnosis...how many hours he is able to work...and if they say this schedule is too restricted, so that it does not let the president work flat out, then in all probability he himself should ask to retire," Gennady Seleznyov said.

He was talking to reporters after meeting the Japanese ambassador to Moscow and was commenting on the forthcoming doctors' council, expected on Wednesday, which is due to rule on whether Yeltsin is fit for the surgery.

Seleznyov referred to Yeltsin's televised address on September 5, when the 65-year-old Russian leader said he was given a choice of either having the heart operation or limiting himself to "a passive" way of life.

"When he spoke on television he told the viewers that if there were no operation his work schedule would have to be easy. And the situation in Russia is such that (the president) cannot have an easy work schedule," Seleznyov said.
